text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with Admire 
Vega...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the end of Admire Vega's gaze was a 
crane game filled with plushies modeled 
after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I was just wondering if someone might 
want it. Not me, of course.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
............ It's nothing. I need to get 
back and train soon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even as she said that, Admire Vega looked 
as if she were reluctant to leave. All 
right, in that case—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Like I said, I'm not really...
choice_data_list:
Maybe you'll change your mind once you get 
it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
